tim_banished_governor_effects_tt.en: Establish [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetName] as a [target_reform.GetName] in the [area|e]. This will ensure that [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetSheHe] will not be able to become our [heir|e], but [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetSheHe] may gain events to gather support against us.\n\nThe [area|e] may be inherited by the [heir|e] of [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetName] after [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetHisHer] death.
tim_banished_governor_effects_tt.uk: Призначити [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetName] як [target_reform.GetName] в [Concept('area','область')|e]. Це забезпечить те, що [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetSheHe] не зможе стати нашим [Concept('heir','спадкоємець')|e], але [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetSheHe] може отримувати події для збору підтримки проти нас.\n\n[Concept('area','область')|e] може бути успадкована [Concept('heir','спадкоємець')|e] [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetName] після [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetHisHer] смерті.

tim_educational_governor_effects_tt.en: Establish [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetName] as a [target_reform.GetName] in the [area|e]. This will ensure that [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetSheHe] will gain more [total_ability|e] from [events|e], but the [area|e] may lose [development|e] and [prosperity|e] in the process.\n\nThe [area|e] may be inherited after [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetName] has governed the [area|e] for #Y 10#! years, or [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetSheHe] could become a [ShowGovernmentReformName('soyurghal_governor_effective_governor_reform')].
tim_educational_governor_effects_tt.uk: Призначити [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetName] як [target_reform.GetName] в [Concept('area','область')|e]. Це забезпечить те, що [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetSheHe] отримуватиме більше [Concept('total_ability','загальна здібність')|e] з [Concept('events','події')|e], але [Concept('area','область')|e] може втратити [Concept('development','розвиток')|e] та [Concept('prosperity','процвітання')|e] в процесі.\n\n[Concept('area','область')|e] може бути успадкована після того, як [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetName] управлятиме [Concept('area','область')|e] протягом #Y 10#! років, або [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetSheHe] може стати [ShowGovernmentReformName('soyurghal_governor_effective_governor_reform')].

tim_normal_governor_effects_tt.en: Establish [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetName] as a [target_reform.GetName] in the [area|e]. This will ensure that [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetSheHe] will gain positive [events|e] that will increase the [prosperity|e] and [development|e] of the [area|e] depending on the [total_ability|e] of the [character|e].\n\nThe [area|e] will be annexed by us after the death of [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetName].
tim_normal_governor_effects_tt.uk: Призначити [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetName] як [target_reform.GetName] в [Concept('area','область')|e]. Це забезпечить те, що [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetSheHe] отримуватиме позитивні [Concept('events','події')|e], які збільшать [Concept('prosperity','процвітання')|e] та [Concept('development','розвиток')|e] [Concept('area','область')|e] залежно від [Concept('total_ability','загальна здібність')|e] [Concept('character','персонаж')|e].\n\n[Concept('area','область')|e] буде анексована нами після смерті [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetName].
